title: BodySequence
description: A rendering sequence driven by pose assets instead of motion CSVs. hand_motions entries are pose motion description JSONs, not CSVs.

hand_motions.description: Paths to pose motion description JSONs (see pose_motion.json).

frames.description: How many frames to render per motion, spread evenly across the whole timeline. 2 gives the first and last frame. Overridden by --frames on the command line.

hdri.description: Path to an HDR/EXR environment map for world lighting. When omitted the model's own lights are used.

accessories.description: Accessories the body wears for this whole clip. Absent or empty means bare hands; nothing is ever inherited from how the .blend was saved.

hdri_spin_deg.description: Angle the environment map is turned about the vertical axis on the first frame. A yaw, so the horizon stays level at any value.

hdri_spin_step_deg.description: Degrees added to hdri_spin_deg on each following frame, so every frame gets a different slice of the panorama and a different light direction. 0 holds the background still.
